reason: My wife and the office girl already take the phone in the mornings, and the rest goes on the mailbox that I listen to in the van at lunch. That costs me nothing, so I'm not adding another 99 euros a month just so the ones we miss get a text instead.
objection: Half my callers are older people on a landline. For them this is just another answering machine with my name on it, and I already have one of those. On top of that it's a brand-new company with no customers. If they fold in a year, my calls are being forwarded to who knows where.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 14-day check showed real jobs being lost every week, enough that one saved job a month clearly pays the fee. Even then I'd want it closer to 49 euros.
